sentences.zh: 災異五

translations.literal: Portents and Anomalies 5
translations.idiomatic: Portents and Anomalies 5

sentences.zh: 洪範曰：「土爰稼穡。

translations.literal: The Great Plan says: "Earth brings forth cultivation."
translations.idiomatic: The Great Plan states, "Earth is defined as bringing forth the harvest."

sentences.zh: 」不成則為咎徵。

translations.literal: "When it is not achieved, it becomes a sign of blame."
translations.idiomatic: When earth fails in this office, the result is a sign of cosmic blame."

sentences.zh: 凡恒風霾、晦冥、花妖、蟲孽、牛禍、地震、山頹、雨毛、地生毛、年饑、黃眚、黃祥皆屬之於土。

translations.literal: All persistent wind and haze, gloom and darkness, floral prodigies, insect portents, bovine calamities, earthquakes, mountain collapses, fiber rain, hair growing from the ground, years of famine, yellow calamities, and yellow omens are all classified under earth.
translations.idiomatic: Persistent unseasonable wind and haze, unnatural darkness, floral prodigies, insect plagues, bovine calamities, earthquakes, mountain collapses, fiber-like rain, hair sprouting from the soil, famine years, and yellow portents of every kind all belong to the element of earth.

sentences.zh: 順治二年七月，湖州大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of Shunzhi 2, Huzhou had a great wind that uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year of Shunzhi, a violent wind at Huzhou uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，孝感大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year, Xiaogan had a great wind that uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year, a violent wind at Xiaogan uprooted trees.

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fifth year, Wuwei Prefecture had a great wind that destroyed houses and uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fifth year, a violent wind at Wuwei Prefecture destroyed houses and uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 八月，海豐颶風，毀廬舍無算。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Haifeng suffered a typhoon that destroyed countless dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, a typhoon at Haifeng destroyed countless dwellings.

sentences.zh: 六年正月，潞安飆風大作。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year, Lu'an was struck by a violent squall.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixth year, a raging squall swept Lu'an.

sentences.zh: 五月，五河狂風晝夜不息，大木盡拔。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Wuhe had a violent wind that did not cease day or night, and all large trees were uprooted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, a violent wind at Wuhe raged day and night without cease, uprooting every large tree.

sentences.zh: 八月，惠來颶風大作，四晝夜不息，毀官署民舍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Huilai was struck by a great typhoon that did not cease for four days and nights, destroying government offices and civilian dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, a fierce typhoon at Huilai raged for four days and nights without abating, destroying government offices and private homes.

sentences.zh: 七年二月，阜陽、襄陽、漳南大風，拔木覆屋。

translations.literal: In the second month of the seventh year, Fuyang, Xiangyang, and Zhangnan had great winds that uprooted trees and collapsed houses.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the seventh year, violent winds at Fuyang, Xiangyang, and Zhangnan uprooted trees and collapsed houses.

sentences.zh: 九年五月，東陽大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the ninth year, Dongyang had a great wind that uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the ninth year, a violent wind at Dongyang uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 十年八月，澄海颶風大作，舟吹陸地，屋飛空中，官署民房盡毀，壓斃男婦不計其數，從來颶風未有如此甚者。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the tenth year, Chenghai was struck by a great typhoon; boats were blown onto land, houses flew through the air, government offices and civilian dwellings were all destroyed, and men and women crushed to death were beyond counting—never had a typhoon been so severe.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the tenth year, a typhoon of unprecedented violence struck Chenghai, blowing boats onto dry land and houses through the air, leveling every government office and private dwelling, and crushing countless men and women to death—no typhoon within living memory had ever been so devastating.

sentences.zh: 十一年二月，太湖大風，毀城內牌坊。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eleventh year, Taihu had a great wind that destroyed memorial arches within the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eleventh year, a violent wind at Taihu destroyed the memorial arches within the city walls.

translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, a fierce typhoon at Quanjiao tore every roof tile from its moorings.

translations.idiomatic: On the fifth day of the second month of the twenty-second year, a violent wind at Shan County raised dust that blotted out the sky, which in an instant shifted through five colors.

translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the ninth year, peach trees at Chongyang blossomed again.

sentences.zh: 十月，宜昌桃李華。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Yichang had peach and plum trees blossom.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, peach and plum trees blossomed at Yichang.

sentences.zh: 十年九月，嘉興桃李華。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the tenth year, Jiaxing had peach and plum trees blossom.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the tenth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Jiaxing.

sentences.zh: 十一月，麻城桃再華。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Macheng had peach blossom again.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, peach trees at Macheng blossomed again.

sentences.zh: 同治元年十月，襄陽桃李華。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Tongzhi, Xiangyang had peach and plum trees blossom.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the first year of Tongzhi, peach and plum trees blossomed at Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 二年冬，通州桃李華。

translations.literal: In the winter of the second year, Tongzhou had peach and plum trees blossom.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the second year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 四年冬，房縣桃李華。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fourth year, Fang County had peach and plum trees blossom.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the fourth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Fang County.

sentences.zh: 八年冬，黃安桃再華。

translations.literal: In the winter of the eighth year, Huang'an had peach blossom again.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the eighth year, peach trees at Huang'an blossomed again.

sentences.zh: 十二年九月，惠民桃李華。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the twelfth year, Huimin had peach and plum trees blossom.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the twelfth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Huimin.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年十一月，莊浪桃杏華。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the first year of Guangxu, peach and apricot blossomed at Zhuanglang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the first year of Guangxu, peach and apricot blossomed at Zhuanglang.

sentences.zh: 四年冬，武昌、光化桃李華。

translations.literal: In the winter of the fourth year, Wuchang and Guanghua had peach and plum trees blossom.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the fourth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Wuchang and Guanghua.

sentences.zh: 五年冬至時，高淳群花齊放，宛如春色。

translations.literal: At the winter solstice of the fifth year, all manner of flowers opened together at Gaochun, like spring colors.
translations.idiomatic: At the winter solstice of the fifth year, flowers of every kind opened together at Gaochun, as though spring had returned.

sentences.zh: 六年七月，歸州桃李華。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the sixth year, Guizhou had peach and plum trees blossom.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the sixth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 九月，蒼溪桃再華。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Cangxi had peach blossom again.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, peach trees at Cangxi blossomed again.

sentences.zh: 九年冬，興山桃李華。

translations.literal: In the winter of the ninth year, Xingshan had peach and plum trees blossom.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the ninth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Xingshan.

sentences.zh: 十二年九月，南樂杏再華。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the twelfth year, Nanle had apricot blossom again.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the twelfth year, apricot trees at Nanle blossomed again.

sentences.zh: 二十四年十月，南樂桃李華。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the twenty-fourth year, Nanle had peach and plum trees blossom.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the twenty-fourth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Nanle.

sentences.zh: 三十二年秋，靖遠桃李華。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the thirty-second year, Jingyuan had peach and plum trees blossom.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the thirty-second year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Jingyuan.

sentences.zh: 三十四年八月，固原桃李華。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the thirty-fourth year, Guyuan had peach and plum trees blossom.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the thirty-fourth year, peach and plum trees blossomed at Guyuan.

sentences.zh: 順治十七年八月，玉屏黑蟲蔽山，草木皆盡。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the seventeenth year of Shunzhi, black insects at Yuping covered the mountains and consumed all vegetation.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the seventeenth year of Shunzhi, black insects at Yuping swarmed over the mountains and stripped the land bare of vegetation.

sentences.zh: 康熙十年秋，潮州蟲生五色，大如指，長三寸，食稼。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the tenth year of Kangxi, Chaozhou produced insects of five colors, as large as a finger and three inches long, which ate the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the tenth year of Kangxi, Chaozhou was infested with five-colored insects as large as a finger and three inches long, which devoured the standing grain.

sentences.zh: 十一年七月，杭州雨蟲，食穗。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the eleventh year, Hangzhou had a rain of insects that ate the grain ears.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the eleventh year, insects rained down on Hangzhou and devoured the grain ears.

sentences.zh: 十二年七月，萬載蟲食禾。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the twelfth year, insects at Wanzi ate the grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twelfth year, insects at Wanzi devoured the standing grain.

sentences.zh: 十三年三月，寧都屋上有生黑蟲者，著人甚痛。

translations.literal: In the third month of the thirteenth year, at Ningdu there were black insects appearing on house roofs; contact with them caused great pain.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the thirteenth year, black insects appeared on rooftops at Ningdu, and contact with them caused intense pain.

sentences.zh: 十七年七月，崇明出兩頭蟲，首尾皆喙，齧草如刈。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the seventeenth year, Chongming produced two-headed insects with beaks at both ends, which gnawed grass as if it were being mowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the seventeenth year, Chongming was beset by two-headed insects with beaks at both ends that gnawed the grass as if a scythe had passed over it.

sentences.zh: 十九年六月，婺源青蟲害稼。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the nineteenth year, green insects at Wuyuan harmed the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the nineteenth year, green insects at Wuyuan damaged the standing grain.

sentences.zh: 二十年二月，鄖陽蟲災。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twentieth year, Yunyang had an insect disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twentieth year, Yunyang suffered an insect plague.

sentences.zh: 二十一年五月，金華蟲災。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twenty-first year, Jinhua had an insect disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twenty-first year, Jinhua suffered an insect plague.

sentences.zh: 二十二年四月，恩施蟲災。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twenty-second year, Enshi had an insect disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the twenty-second year, Enshi suffered an insect plague.

sentences.zh: 二十三年五月，渠縣有蟲數萬斛，似蝗，黑色，頭銳，有翅，嗅之甚臭。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twenty-third year, at Quxian there were insects numbering tens of thousands of hu, resembling locusts, black, with sharp heads and wings; they smelled extremely foul.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twenty-third year, Quxian was overrun by insects numbering in the tens of thousands of hu—locust-like, black, sharp-headed, and winged, and foul-smelling beyond measure.

sentences.zh: 二十七年七月，蘇州、青浦蟲災。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the twenty-seventh year, Suzhou and Qingpu had an insect disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twenty-seventh year, Suzhou and Qingpu suffered an insect plague.

sentences.zh: 二十九年四月，沁水白黑蟲食禾，結繭。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twenty-ninth year, white and black insects at Qinshui ate the grain and spun cocoons.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the twenty-ninth year, white and black insects at Qinshui devoured the grain and spun cocoons.

sentences.zh: 三十年三月，萬載青蟲食禾。

translations.literal: In the third month of the thirtieth year, green insects at Wanzi ate the grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the thirtieth year, green insects at Wanzi devoured the standing grain.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，遵化州生蟲，似槐蟲而黑，食稼幾盡。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year, Zunhua Prefecture produced insects resembling locust-tree worms but black, which nearly consumed all the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year, Zunhua Prefecture was infested with black insects resembling locust-tree worms that nearly devoured the entire harvest.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，貴縣生蟲，食豆。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year, insects appeared at Guixian and ate the beans.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-ninth year, insects at Guixian devoured the bean crop.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，昭化有蟲如蠶，食禾。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year, at Zhaohua there were insects like silkworms that ate the grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year, silkworm-like insects at Zhaohua devoured the standing grain.

sentences.zh: 四十五年二月，房縣蟲食禾。

translations.literal: In the second month of the forty-fifth year, insects at Fang County ate the grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the forty-fifth year, insects at Fang County devoured the standing grain.

sentences.zh: 夏，霑化有蟲似螳螂而金色，識者曰，此蒼諸也，見則歲凶。

translations.literal: In summer, at Zhanhua there were insects resembling golden mantises; those who recognized them said, "These are cangzhu; when they appear, the year will be famine-stricken."
translations.idiomatic: That summer, Zhanhua was visited by golden, mantis-like insects that the learned identified as cangzhu—creatures whose appearance presaged a year of famine.

sentences.zh: 四十九年五月，井陘五色蟲生。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the forty-ninth year, five-colored insects appeared at Jingxing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the forty-ninth year, five-colored insects appeared at Jingxing.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，鶴慶蟲食禾。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year, insects at Heqing ate the grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-sixth year, insects at Heqing devoured the standing grain.

sentences.zh: 五十七年夏，新樂生蟲，青色，傷禾。

translations.literal: In the summer of the fifty-seventh year, insects appeared at Xinle, green in color, damaging the grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the fifty-seventh year, green insects at Xinle damaged the standing grain.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年七月，鎮海麥莖生蟲，頭紅身黑，狀如蠶。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year of Yongzheng, insects appeared on wheat stalks at Zhenhai, red-headed and black-bodied, shaped like silkworms.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year of Yongzheng, wheat stalks at Zhenhai sprouted red-headed, black-bodied worms shaped like silkworms.

sentences.zh: 十年秋，清河禾生蟲，形似蛆，有毛，紅色。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the tenth year, grain at Qinghe produced insects shaped like maggots, hairy and red.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the tenth year, the grain at Qinghe was afflicted with hairy red maggot-like insects.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十七年八月，仁和蟲食稼。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the seventeenth year of Qianlong, insects at Renhe ate the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the seventeenth year of Qianlong, insects at Renhe devoured the standing grain.

sentences.zh: 二十年春，臨安蟲災。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twentieth year, Lin'an had an insect disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the twentieth year, Lin'an suffered an insect plague.

sentences.zh: 二十一年六月，景寧有白蟲無數自南來。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twenty-first year, at Jingning countless white insects came from the south.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twenty-first year, countless white insects swept into Jingning from the south.

sentences.zh: 二十三年秋，海寧雨蠶。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the twenty-third year, silkworms rained at Haining.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the twenty-third year, silkworms rained down on Haining.

sentences.zh: 二十四年八月，武邑有乚蟲食禾根。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twenty-fourth year, at Wuyi worms appeared that ate the roots of the grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twenty-fourth year, worms at Wuyi devoured the roots of the standing grain.

sentences.zh: 三十年十月，嘉興蟲災。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the thirtieth year, Jiaxing had an insect disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the thirtieth year, Jiaxing suffered an insect plague.

sentences.zh: 三十八年春，青浦河水生蟲，色紅，狀如蜈蚣，長三四寸，昏暮始見。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirty-eighth year, insects appeared in the river water at Qingpu, red in color, shaped like centipedes, three or four inches long, visible only at dusk.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the thirty-eighth year, red centipede-like insects three or four inches long appeared in the river at Qingpu, visible only at dusk.

sentences.zh: 六十年正月，平度蟲災。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixtieth year, Pingdu had an insect disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixtieth year, Pingdu suffered an insect plague.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶九年夏，洛川蟲傷禾。

translations.literal: In the summer of the ninth year of Jiaqing, insects at Luochuan damaged the grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the ninth year of Jiaqing, insects at Luochuan damaged the standing grain.

sentences.zh: 道光五年七月，滕縣生五色蟲，食禾殆盡。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifth year of Daoguang, five-colored insects appeared at Teng County and nearly consumed all the grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year of Daoguang, five-colored insects at Teng County nearly devoured the entire harvest.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年六月，崇陽蟲災。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Xianfeng, Chongyang had an insect disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of Xianfeng, Chongyang suffered an insect plague.

sentences.zh: 九年五月，蘇州禾田中出蟲，名曰稻鱉。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the ninth year, insects appeared in the rice fields at Suzhou, called daobie.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the ninth year, insects called daobie appeared in the rice fields at Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 同治四年秋，秀水有青蟲如蠶，喙黑，卷葉作網。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the fourth year of Tongzhi, at Xiushui there were green insects like silkworms, with black mouthparts, that rolled leaves into webs.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the fourth year of Tongzhi, Xiushui was plagued by green silkworm-like insects with black mouthparts that rolled leaves into webs.

sentences.zh: 十三年九月，嘉興田禾生蟲，食根，似黑蟻，蜂腰，六足，有須。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the thirteenth year, insects appeared in the grain fields at Jiaxing that ate the roots, resembling black ants, with wasp waists, six legs, and antennae.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the thirteenth year, root-eating insects appeared in the grain fields at Jiaxing—black-ant-like creatures with pinched waists, six legs, and antennae.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年八月，寧津蟲傷稼。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year of Guangxu, insects at Ningjin damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year of Guangxu, insects at Ningjin damaged the standing grain.

sentences.zh: 十四年春，泰安蟲災。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourteenth year, Tai'an had an insect disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourteenth year, Tai'an suffered an insect plague.

sentences.zh: 順治元年二月，萊陽民家牛產犢，一體二首。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Shunzhi, a commoner's ox at Laiyang gave birth to a calf with one body and two heads.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of Shunzhi, a farmer's ox at Laiyang bore a calf with one body and two heads.

sentences.zh: 二年二月，交城民家牛產一犢，遍體鱗甲。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year, a commoner's ox at Jiaocheng gave birth to a calf covered entirely in scales.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year, a farmer's ox at Jiaocheng bore a calf covered from head to tail in scales.

sentences.zh: 十年，文縣民家牛產兩麟。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, a commoner's ox at Wen County gave birth to two qilin.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, a farmer's ox at Wen County bore two qilin.

sentences.zh: 十六年，定州民家牛產麟。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, a commoner's ox at Dingzhou gave birth to a qilin.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, a farmer's ox at Dingzhou bore a qilin.

sentences.zh: 康熙五年，南昌民家牛產麟。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Kangxi, a commoner's ox at Nanchang gave birth to a qilin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Kangxi, a farmer's ox at Nanchang bore a qilin.

sentences.zh: 十三年七月，巫山民家牛產一犢，三目四耳，舌端有鈌，胸列四蹄，脊後分為二身，各二蹄一尾。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the thirteenth year, a commoner's ox at Wushan gave birth to a calf with three eyes and four ears, a hook at the tip of its tongue, four hooves arrayed on its chest, and after its spine the body divided into two, each with two hooves and one tail.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the thirteenth year, a farmer's ox at Wushan bore a calf with three eyes and four ears, a hook at the tip of its tongue, four hooves on its chest, and a spine that divided into two bodies, each with two hooves and a tail.

sentences.zh: 十五年，池州民家牛產犢，二首八足。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, a commoner's ox at Chizhou gave birth to a calf with two heads and eight legs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, a farmer's ox at Chizhou bore a calf with two heads and eight legs.

sentences.zh: 十七年六月，鎮洋民家牛產犢，兩頭。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the seventeenth year, a commoner's ox at Zhenyang gave birth to a calf with two heads.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the seventeenth year, a farmer's ox at Zhenyang bore a two-headed calf.

sentences.zh: 二十八年九月，餘姚北鄉民家牛產麟，狼項、馬足、麕身，遍體鱗甲，金紫相錯。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the twenty-eighth year, a commoner's ox in the northern township of Yuyao gave birth to a qilin with a wolf's neck, horse's legs, and a body like a hornless deer, covered entirely in scales with gold and purple intermingled.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the twenty-eighth year, a farmer's ox in northern Yuyao bore a qilin with a wolf's neck, horse's legs, and a deer-like body, its hide entirely scaly in mingled gold and purple.

sentences.zh: 三十八年，景寧民家牛產麟。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year, a commoner's ox at Jingning gave birth to a qilin.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-eighth year, a farmer's ox at Jingning bore a qilin.

sentences.zh: 雍正七年，鎮海民家牛生一犢，遍體鱗紋，色青黑，頷下有髯，項皆細鱗。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yongzheng, a commoner's ox at Zhenhai gave birth to a calf covered entirely in scale patterns, blue-black in color, with a beard beneath the jaw and fine scales along the neck.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Yongzheng, a farmer's ox at Zhenhai bore a calf covered in blue-black scales, bearded beneath the jaw and fine-scaled along the neck.

sentences.zh: 十一年五月，鹽亭民家牛產一麟，高二尺五寸，肉角一，長寸許，目如水晶，鱗甲遍體，兩脊傍至尾各有肉粒如豆，黃金色，麕身，八足，牛蹄，產時風雨交至，金光滿院，射草木皆黃。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eleventh year, a commoner's ox at Yanting gave birth to a qilin two feet five inches tall, with one fleshy horn about an inch long, eyes like crystal, scales covering the entire body, along both sides of the spine to the tail fleshy grains like beans in golden yellow, a body like a hornless deer, eight legs with ox hooves; at birth wind and rain came together, golden light filled the courtyard, and grass and trees turned yellow in its radiance.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eleventh year, a farmer's ox at Yanting bore a qilin two feet five inches tall, with a fleshy horn an inch long, crystal-clear eyes, and scales from head to tail studded with golden bean-sized nodules along the spine; deer-bodied and eight-legged with ox hooves, it was born amid driving wind and rain as golden light flooded the courtyard and turned grass and trees yellow in its glow.

sentences.zh: 十三年二月，綿州民家牛產一犢，首形如龍，身有鱗紋，無毛，落地而殤。

translations.literal: In the second month of the thirteenth year, a commoner's ox at Mianzhou gave birth to a calf with a head shaped like a dragon, a body with scale patterns and no hair, which died upon touching the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the thirteenth year, a farmer's ox at Mianzhou bore a hairless, dragon-headed calf covered in scale patterns; it died the moment it touched the ground.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四年，盛京民家牛產麟。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qianlong, a commoner's ox at Shengjing gave birth to a qilin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Qianlong, a farmer's ox at Shengjing bore a qilin.

sentences.zh: 五年，壽州民家牛產麟，一室火光，眾以為怪，格殺之，剝皮，見周身鱗甲，頭角猶隱ю也；

translations.literal: In the fifth year, a commoner's ox at Shouzhou gave birth to a qilin; the room filled with firelight, and the crowd took it for a monster and killed it; upon flaying the hide, scales covered the entire body, and the head and horns were still faintly visible;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, a farmer's ox at Shouzhou bore a qilin amid a blaze of light that filled the room; the crowd, deeming it monstrous, killed it, and when the hide was stripped away, scales covered its entire body and the head and horns were still faintly visible;

sentences.zh: 荊州民家牛產麟，遍體鱗甲。

translations.literal: A commoner's ox at Jingzhou gave birth to a qilin, covered entirely in scales.
translations.idiomatic: A farmer's ox at Jingzhou bore a qilin covered from head to tail in scales.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，崇明見三足牛，前一後二。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, at Chongming a three-legged ox was seen, one leg in front and two behind.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, a three-legged ox was sighted at Chongming, with one foreleg and two hind legs.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，遂安民家牛產麟。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing, a commoner's ox at Suian gave birth to a qilin.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiaqing, a farmer's ox at Suian bore a qilin.

sentences.zh: 二年，平度州民家牛產麟。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year of the Daoguang reign, soil rained at Zhanhua.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year of the Daoguang reign, soil fell as rain over Zhanhua.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年二月，棲霞雨土。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year of the Xianfeng reign, soil rained at Qixia.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year of the Xianfeng reign, soil fell as rain over Qixia.

sentences.zh: 三月，宜昌雨土。

translations.literal: In the third month, soil rained at Yichang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, soil fell as rain over Yichang.

sentences.zh: 六年三月二十三日，咸寧雨土。

translations.literal: On the twenty-third day of the third month of the sixth year of the Xianfeng reign, soil rained at Xian'ning.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-third day of the third month of the sixth year of the Xianfeng reign, soil fell as rain over Xian'ning.

sentences.zh: 同治三年春，麻城雨土。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year of the Tongzhi reign, soil rained at Macheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the third year of the Tongzhi reign, soil fell as rain over Macheng.

sentences.zh: 光緒四年二月二十九日，宜城雨黃沙。

translations.literal: On the twenty-ninth day of the second month of the fourth year of the Guangxu reign, yellow sand rained at Yicheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-ninth day of the second month of the fourth year of the Guangxu reign, yellow sand fell as rain over Yicheng.

sentences.zh: 三月，蓬萊雨土。

translations.literal: In the third month, soil rained at Penglai.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, soil fell as rain over Penglai.
